environment.renderer: native application default; exact renderer not independently identified
environment.language_confirmation: On-screen settings showed primary Chinese and secondary English; unchanged languages.txt predated the baseline run.
environment.provenance: Operator-supplied context for this fixed 2026-10-25 measurement protocol.

methodology.protocol: Item warm-up navigation ordinal0, then four scenarios in fixed order, five rounds; analyze ordinals1..20 only.
methodology.first: First measured visit within each shared process after item warm-up; not fresh OS/disk cache.
methodology.warm: Median/min/max of visits2..5 (four samples), computed independently for each metric.
methodology.preparation: One outer list.publish or list.reload_board span. Nested query/rows/cards/model spans are never added to it.
methodology.first_render: ui.update_to_render measures update start to rendering-notifier completion; not all images loaded or screen-present latency.
methodology.icon_paint: First/last observed icon.paint callback completion relative to navigation. Counts are attempted target updates, including failures; not proof all images are present.
methodology.pending_batches: Observed icon.decode minus icon.queue_wait starts; proxy for waiting UI callbacks, not guaranteed scheduler instrumentation.
methodology.attribution_limit: Events attributed by navigation timestamp until next navigation or subsequent detail.open span start, whichever is first; final ordinal20 is additionally bounded to1000ms after navigation. This excludes later record-opening regression checks that have no navigation marker. Assumes protocol waits for outstanding jobs; nonzero pending count flags possible spillover.
methodology.event_loop_delay: Only recorded delays in first500ms are summarized; timer reports delays >=20ms, so null means no recorded delay, not proven zero.
